name: @sellerops/agent-runtime
description: SellerOps Agent Runtime. A standalone Node/TypeScript orchestration service: LangGraph owns goal parsing, context assembly, tool routing, human checkpoint, and resume; LangChain Tools are thin adapters onto the Spring backend, which stays the system of record for connectors, DB, transactions, idempotency, policy, and audit. No channel API write, no external send — the human checkpoint plus the backend's fail-closed publish gate must both pass first.
